source: When you open the {0}Performance{/0} panel, it instantly shows your local **Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)** and **Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)** scores (good, needs improvement, or bad).
text: Lorsque vous ouvrez le panneau {0}Performance{/0}, il affiche immédiatement vos scores locaux de **Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)** et de **Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)** (bon, à améliorer ou mauvais).
